007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonValue;
010
011import java.util.Locale;
012
013/**
014 * Execution states supported by a Select AI Agent team.
015 *
016 * <p>{@link #UNKNOWN} represents a state introduced by a newer database
017 * release. It allows state retrieval to remain forward-compatible while
018 * preventing an unknown state from being submitted by an execution-state
019 * request.</p>
020 *
021 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/GetTeamStateSample.html">
022 *      GetTeamStateSample source</a>
023 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetTeamExecutionStateSample.html">
024 *      SetTeamExecutionStateSample source</a>
025 * @since 1.1.0
026 */
027public enum TeamExecutionState {
028    /** The team workflow is running. */
029    RUNNING("RUNNING"),
030    /** The workflow is waiting for human input. */
031    WAITING_FOR_HUMAN("WAITING_FOR_HUMAN"),
032    /** The workflow completed successfully. */
033    SUCCEEDED("SUCCEEDED"),
034    /** The workflow failed. */
035    FAILED("FAILED"),
036    /** A state introduced by a newer database release. */
037    UNKNOWN("UNKNOWN");
038
039    /** Database state value. */
040    private final String value;
041
042    TeamExecutionState(String value) {
043        this.value = value;
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * Parses a database state value.
048     *
049     * @param value database state value
050     * @return matching state, or {@link #UNKNOWN} for a newer value
051     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when {@code value} is null or blank
052     */
053    public static TeamExecutionState of(String value) {
054        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
055            throw new IllegalArgumentException("state must not be null or blank");
056        }
057        return switch (value.trim().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
058            case "RUNNING" -> RUNNING;
059            case "WAITING_FOR_HUMAN" -> WAITING_FOR_HUMAN;
060            case "SUCCEEDED" -> SUCCEEDED;
061            case "FAILED" -> FAILED;
062            default -> UNKNOWN;
063        };
064    }
065
066    /**
067     * Returns the database state value.
068     *
069     * @return canonical database state value
070     */
071    @JsonValue
072    public String getValue() {
073        return value;
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * Indicates whether this state is supported by this SDK release.
078     *
079     * @return {@code false} only for {@link #UNKNOWN}
080     */
081    public boolean isKnown() {
082        return this != UNKNOWN;
083    }
084}
